name: DDev Plastiks Industries Ltd
tagline: India's largest listed polymer-compound maker (cable/wire compounds), 30%+ ROCE and debt-free, now adding a Bhiwadi capacity leg (drove Q1 FY27 revenue +29%) and a 5 GWh BESS assembly vertical - trades at only ~15x P/E; the historic KKalpana related-party royalty flag has been cut from 9% to ~2.4% of PAT
business_overview: DDev Plastiks -- India's largest listed polymer compound manufacturer (customised compounds for wires & cables, plus packaging, white goods, industrial applications). Demerged from KKalpana Industries (which remains a promoter-group entity; ongoing trade RPTs and a royalty). New Bhiwadi (Rajasthan) plant commissioned late April 2026. Diversifying into Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) assembly via a capital-efficient 'assembly-led' model (Phase 1 5 GWh, Rs 150-200 Cr, internally funded), project relocated to Kolkata per an Aug-2026 board approval.
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 2,948 Cr (+13.2%), EBITDA Rs 287 Cr (+12%, ~11% margin), PAT Rs 202 Cr (+9%); volumes +6%
Revenue Rs 989 Cr (+28.6% YoY), PAT Rs 63.8 Cr (+22.3% YoY) - Bhiwadi ramp + EBITDA/ton recovery (Rs 19,177 vs Rs 15,304 YoY)
Volume ~231,000 MT (73% utilisation), revenue +13% YoY, EBITDA margin ~11%
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely high-quality returns (ROCE 30%+, ROE ~22%) and a net-cash balance sheet. FY26 was mediocre (revenue +13%, PAT +9%, volumes only +6% against a 12-15% guided target, hit by geopolitics/monsoon), but Q1 FY27 inflected up: revenue +28.6% YoY and PAT +22.3% YoY as the new Bhiwadi (Rajasthan) plant (commercial from late April 2026) ramped, with EBITDA/ton also recovering. FY27 company guidance is more modest (+13% revenue, ~11% margin). On top of the core business sits the BESS assembly optionality (5 GWh Phase 1, Rs 150-200 Cr, internally funded, assembly-led not cell-manufacturing), now relocated to Kolkata and with commissioning timing that has slipped (targeted FY27). The historic governance concern - related-party royalty payments to KKalpana Industries - has been substantially reduced (9% of PAT -> ~2.4%), per a trusted, invested community member; ongoing RPTs are now mostly trade in goods (FY27 approved limits ~Rs 82 Cr). Valuation is undemanding at ~15x P/E / ~3x book for this return profile.
technical_read: Not pulled -- fundamentals and community signal were the primary drivers.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 79 posts (2024-06 to 2026-08). Central new-vertical catalyst: DDev's 5 GWh BESS assembly plant (Phase 1, Rs 150-200 Cr capex, internal accruals) targeting EPC players and utilities via an 'assembly-led' model; commissioning has slipped and the project was moved to Kolkata. Core business: FY26 'mediocre' (missed 12-15% guided volume growth), but Q1 FY27 shows volumes and EBITDA/ton recovering as Bhiwadi ramps.
community_signal: pranavpallod12 (trusted, elevated, invested/disclosed) has provided detailed, consistent quarterly coverage across 8+ posts, and explicitly flagged that the prior related-party royalty red flag (payments to KKalpana Industries) has been substantially reduced -- from 9% of PAT to 2.4% -- alongside acceptable managerial remuneration, concluding 'NO OTHER RED FLAGS' (Aug 2025). kdjolly (trusted, elevated) separately posted a detailed technical breakdown of the BESS assembly-led business model and sourcing strategy (Feb 2026).

trusted_signals.note: Confirmed the prior related-party royalty red flag (payments to KKalpana Industries) was substantially reduced from 9% of PAT (prior year) to 2.4%, alongside acceptable managerial remuneration (Rs 2.2 Cr) -- concluded 'NO OTHER RED FLAGS'. Disclosed as invested.

Posted a detailed technical breakdown of DDev's BESS entry: a capital-efficient 'assembly-led manufacturing' model (not cell manufacturing from scratch), positioning as a BESS systems assembler/supplier for EPC players and utilities.

bse_notes: Aug-2026 board approved relocation of the BESS project to Kolkata (other project details unchanged from the 5-Jan-2026 intimation). CRISIL rating update Jul-2026. FY27 material-RPT limits with KKalpana group approved (~Rs 82 Cr aggregate, largely trade in goods).
bull_case: High-quality core: ROCE 30%+, ROE ~22%, net cash, largest listed player in cable/wire compounds - at only ~15x P/E
New Bhiwadi capacity leg is real and already contributing (Q1 FY27 revenue +29%, PAT +22%); EBITDA/ton recovering
BESS assembly vertical (5 GWh Phase 1, internally funded, capital-efficient) is genuine optionality validated in detail by a trusted user
Historic governance red flag (KKalpana royalty) substantially and verifiably reduced (9% -> 2.4% of PAT)
Undemanding valuation for the return profile leaves room if either the core acceleration sustains or BESS lands
bear_case: FY26 missed its own 12-15% volume guidance; FY27 company guidance is only +13% revenue - core is a mid-teens compounder, not a hyper-grower
BESS commissioning has slipped and the plant was relocated - execution-timeline risk on the very catalyst the upside rests on; assembly-led model has thin margins and unproven demand
Structural related-party dependence on KKalpana Industries (promoter group) persists via trade RPTs and royalty, even if reduced
Compounds is a partly commoditised, raw-material-price-sensitive business; moat is scale/formulation, not pricing power
Q1 FY27 acceleration is capacity-led (Bhiwadi base effect) and needs another 2-3 quarters to confirm it is durable
verdict_headline: Deep-dive pass 1: high-quality debt-free compounder at only ~15x P/E with a genuine new capacity leg (Q1 FY27 +29% revenue) plus BESS optionality and a reduced governance flag - four_box moves to 3.0, thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years, conviction held at Medium pending BESS execution and 2-3 quarters confirming the core re-acceleration
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind yes (wire & cable / power-infra demand + BESS), tam weak (core is a mid-teens-growth compound market; BESS TAM large but capture unproven), moat weak (scale + formulation edge, 30%+ ROCE, but partly commoditised and RM-price sensitive), valuation yes (~15x P/E / ~3x book does not price in either the Bhiwadi leg or BESS) -> score 3.0, which permits the 10x label.

Q1 FY27 (+28.6% revenue, +22.3% PAT) is a real inflection versus the FY26 volume stall, driven by the Bhiwadi plant; but company FY27 guidance is only +13%, so the re-acceleration needs 2-3 more quarters to be judged durable.

Two trusted, invested/engaged users independently corroborate the reduced governance risk (KKalpana royalty 9% -> 2.4% of PAT) and the substance of the BESS opportunity - more than a speculative narrative.

Conviction held to Medium: BESS commissioning has slipped and been relocated, the assembly-led model is thin-margin and unproven, and the structural KKalpana RPT relationship persists. No red flag; no conviction floor (no trusted directional 10x call).
notes_short: ~15x P/E, ROCE 30%+, net cash; Bhiwadi leg drove Q1 FY27 +29% revenue; BESS 5GWh optionality (delayed, moved to Kolkata); KKalpana royalty flag cut 9%->2.4% of PAT

BESS project relocated to Kolkata; commissioning timing has slipped (now FY27).
Valuation is ~15x P/E / ~3x book - undemanding for a 30%+ ROCE net-cash compounder.

open_questions: Does the Q1 FY27 re-acceleration sustain, or does it fade to the guided +13% once the Bhiwadi base effect passes?
When does the BESS Phase-1 plant actually commission, and what order/customer visibility exists for the assembly-led model?
Can the assembly-led BESS model earn acceptable ROCE at scale, or is it a low-margin systems-integration business?
Will KKalpana-group RPTs stay contained now that limits have been re-approved at ~Rs 82 Cr?
deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium -> Medium. The Q1 FY27 capacity-led inflection, undemanding ~15x valuation, high returns and reduced governance flag strengthen the case, but BESS timing slippage/relocation, a modest +13% FY27 core guidance and the persistent KKalpana RPT relationship keep conviction at Medium.

value_chain.note: Core compound business roughly tracks cable-industry capex; DDev's edge is scale + formulation breadth + captive feedstock relationships. BESS assembly-led model keeps capital light but competes in a crowded, still-forming market.

mix shift toward exports and value-added compounds (EBITDA/ton up ~25% YoY)
earnings_quality.normalised_note: EBITDA margin has held around 11% and EBITDA/ton is recovering off a FY26 trough, not sitting at a peak. The risk is RM-price volatility compressing spreads, not mean-reversion from an elevated margin.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: YoY revenue growth oldest->newest roughly: low-single-digit through FY26 (volumes +6% FY26, Q4 +3.9%), then Q1 FY27 +28.6% as Bhiwadi came online. Acceleration is capacity-led; company FY27 guidance is a more modest +13%.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~15x trailing needs only ~8-10% EPS CAGR to be fair at an 18x exit; Q1 FY27 is running well above that, so recent rate-of-change supports the multiple with room to spare - if it sustains.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvested internal accruals into Bhiwadi capacity and the BESS vertical at high incremental ROCE (~30%); no debt raised, no unrelated diversification beyond the adjacent BESS move. Dividend paid but modest. Historic value leakage via KKalpana royalty now reduced.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Moving up from commodity compounds toward value-added/export mix; adjacent step into BESS systems assembly

track_record.note: FY23-FY26 verifiable post-demerger. ROCE cleared >=15% in all four years (30%+ range). Revenue growth exceeded 10% in about two of the four (FY23 post-demerger ramp and FY26 +13.2%); FY24-FY25 were sub-10% on demand softness. So ~2 of 4 years passed BOTH tests.

four_box.note: tailwind yes (wire & cable / power-infra demand + BESS); tam weak (core is a mid-teens-growth compound market, BESS TAM large but capture unproven); moat weak (scale + formulation edge, 30%+ ROCE, but partly commoditised, RM-price sensitive); valuation yes (~15x P/E / ~3x book prices in neither the Bhiwadi leg nor BESS). Score 3.0 permits the 10x label; conviction Medium on BESS execution + core guidance only +13%.
